title: gonostemon asterias var. gibbus

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gonostemon asterias var. gibbus are attributed to its antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may also help to protect against cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer.
